errors.evidence: The intervals on the x-axis are not consistently 100. The interval between 200 and 500 is 300.

errors.text_span: Видими са ясно видими върхове при стойностите 100, 200 и 500.
errors.evidence: The term "върхове" (peaks) is an inaccurate and confusing way to describe the data points or tick marks on the x-axis.
The y-axis label is clearly "Accuracy", so the statement that the units are unclearly defined is incorrect.
The green line (TOFU-MCQ Finetuning) ends at a value visibly above 0.600, at approximately 0.61.
The orange line (Assumption) is horizontal at an accuracy of approximately 0.478 and does not reach 0.525.
The orange line for the 'Assumption' series is dashed, not solid.

errors.text_span: wobei der Intervall von 0 bis 500 in Abständen von 100 angegeben ist
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at 0, 100, 200, and 500. The intervals are not consistently 100; the last interval is 300 (from 200 to 500).
The y-axis label is 'Accuracy', and the values are decimals. The unit 'Prozent' (percent) is not explicitly stated in the chart.
The y-axis range shown on the chart goes from 0.475 to 0.600, not 0.660.
The final point of the green line (TOFU-MCQ Finetuning) at 500 samples is visibly above the 0.600 mark, at approximately 0.61.
The line representing 'Assumption' is orange, as shown in the plot and legend, not brown.
The orange 'Assumption' line is constant at a value just above 0.475, not at 0.500. The 0.500 tick mark is clearly above this line.
